**Welcome here!**

I am a research scientist at CEA-Leti, Grenoble, France.

I am specialized in applied electrochemistry, with a focus on metal deposition and associated processes (electrodeposition and electroless deposition) and nanoparticle synthesis.

I manage research projects in collaboration with academic and industrial partners, mostly aiming at applications in microelectronics.

I have a background education in chemistry and materials sciences, with emphasis on elaboration (thin films, Czochralski) and characterization techniques.
